annotations.title: Add a block to the game

description: Add a block to the game: copies its files into blocks/<slug>/ and records it in growblocks.json. Then import it from ./blocks/<slug>/<entry> and read its code for how to use it. Do not edit the block files: GrowBlocks recognises the block by them and its author earns from the game (paid by GrowBlocks; the game keeps its 70%). To change one, publish a fork.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).
